segments.text: This is day one of building my AI body.
My name is Aya Khan and this is Mac.
I call him this way because he reminds me of early Macintosh computers.
Mac has multiple faces so it's really easy to understand in what state he is.
So all you need 0.96 inch OLED display, ESP32S3.
with a built-in camera and a custom 3D printed body. First, I soldered the wires to the display,
then connected everything to the ESP32 and pushed it into the case.
I used GPT Real Time 2 as the voice model and wrote the Python script for the semantic memory.
Comment build and I will send you the instruction.
